implementation.producer: Version/SHA-guarded persistent PptxGenJS 4.0.1 patch during installation and build; coordinated object IDs with media reservations and noncolliding slide-number allocation.
implementation.validation: Namespace-aware generated-OOXML checks with slide/object/property locators; rejects duplicate nonvisual IDs, invalid text/table anchors, negative extents, malformed XML and unsupported AlternateContent shape trees before delivery.
implementation.limitations: Targeted generated-output checks, not full OOXML schema validation, layout QA, semantic reconciliation or general connector/timing reference repair.
